name: Hepta Runtime CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - hepta-runtime-base
      - 'feature/**'
      - 'feat/**'
      - 'codex/**'
      - 'fix/**'
      - 'perf/**'
      - 'experiment/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - hepta-runtime-base
      - feature/rea-native-foundation-20261102
      - feature/rea-runtime-unified-20261103
      - work/native-runtime-convergence-20261030
      # Candidate branches are protected by exact HEAD and synthetic-merge gates.
      # Stacked fix and integration PRs otherwise receive no CI event.
      - 'fix/**'
      - 'perf/**'
      - 'experiment/**'
      - 'dot/**'
      - 'codex/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Oxc qualification produced 8.4 GB of incremental state; retain normal
# debug/test semantics while avoiding duplicate CI incremental caches.
env:
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  runtime-head-ci:
    name: Rust exact-head validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact source HEAD
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Verify checked-out source identity
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA"
          printf 'SOURCE_HEAD_SHA=%s\n' "$EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA"

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
          rustup component add rustfmt clippy --toolchain 1.95.0
          rustup default 1.95.0
          rustc --version
          cargo --version

      - name: Format
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Check all targets
        run: cargo check --locked --all-targets --all-features

      - name: Check all targets without remote filesystem
        run: cargo check --locked --all-targets --no-default-features

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Clippy without remote filesystem
        run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --no-default-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Install pinned nextest
        run: |
          cargo install --locked --version '=0.9.137' cargo-nextest
          cargo nextest --version

      - name: Install integration test tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y ripgrep python3-jsonschema
          rg --version

      - name: Test in isolated processes
        run: |
          umask 022
          cargo nextest run --locked --all-targets --all-features \
            --test-threads 1 --retries 0 --no-fail-fast

      - name: Descriptor-relative file safety
        run: /usr/bin/python3 tests/file_capabilities.py

      - name: Frozen REA local mapping checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/rea_compatibility_ledger_tests.py -v
          /usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/rea_compatibility_ledger.py check-mapping

      - name: REA qualification evidence regressions
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'rea_*tests.py' -v

      - name: Control-plane regression
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/runtime_registry_page_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/test_native_canary_resume.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_v11_layered_read_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_v11_process_start_concurrency_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_v11_v4_session_binding_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/runtime_workflow_owner_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_v10_single_v4_effect_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_v10_stream_custody_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/test_computer_http.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/full_operator_facade_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/full_operator_cancel_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_request_identity_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/full_operator_session_recovery_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/rea_browser_capture_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B deploy/maintenance_20261017/native_rollout_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B deploy/maintenance_20261017/recover_control_channel_tests.py

      - name: X230 qualification evidence regressions
        run: |
          /usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tools/x230/20261028 -p '*_tests.py' -v
          /usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tools/x230/20261029 -p '*_tests.py' -v
          /usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tools/x230/20261030 -p '*_tests.py' -v

      - name: Test without remote filesystem in isolated processes
        run: |
          umask 022
          cargo nextest run --locked --all-targets --no-default-features \
            --test-threads 1 --retries 0 --no-fail-fast

      - name: Release build
        run: cargo build --locked --all-features --release --bins --examples

      - name: Release JavaScript MCP cancellation and recovery
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, os, subprocess, sys
          from pathlib import Path
          binary = Path("target/release/hepta-runtime").resolve(strict=True)
          with binary.open("rb") as stream:
              digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
          subprocess.run([
              sys.executable, "-u", "tests/rea_javascript_cancellation_external.py",
              "--runtime", str(binary), "--expected-runtime-sha256", digest,
              "--workspace", str(Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "rea-javascript-cancellation"),
              "--allow-owned-child-signals", "--allow-local-mcp",
          ], check=True)
          PY

      - name: Retain JavaScript cancellation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: rea-js-cancellation-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/rea-javascript-cancellation/
            !${{ runner.temp }}/rea-javascript-cancellation/hepta-runtime-qualified
            !${{ runner.temp }}/rea-javascript-cancellation/state/**
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Release binary REA parser and Linux syscall-denial smoke
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          binary="./target/release/hepta-runtime"
          test -x "$binary"
          printf '\x00asm\x01\x00\x00\x00' | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/release.wasm > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-good.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-good.err"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-good.err"
          python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["record_format"]=="hepta.rea.preview.v1" and r["normalized_result"]["format"]=="wasm" and r["rea_evidence_compatible"] is False and r["coverage"]["status"]=="partial"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-good.json"

          printf '\x00asm\x01\x00\x00\x00' | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/release.wasm --sandbox-probe > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-sandbox.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-sandbox.err"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-sandbox.err"
          python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["status"]=="file_and_network_syscalls_denied"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-sandbox.json"

          if printf '\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01' | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/invalid.elf > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-bad.out" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-bad.err"; then
            echo "ERROR: release worker accepted truncated ELF" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-bad.out"
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-bad.err"

      - name: Independent Python ZIP writer to shipped Rust worker static checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          binary="./target/release/hepta-runtime"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, zipfile
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "rea-zip-evidence"
          good = root / "apk-like-structural-only.zip"
          with zipfile.ZipFile(good, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_STORED) as archive:
              archive.writestr("AndroidManifest.xml", b"not a real Android manifest")
              archive.writestr("classes.dex", b"not actual dex code")
              archive.writestr("resources.arsc", b"not actual resources")
              archive.writestr("META-INF/CERT.RSA", b"not a real certificate")
          (root / "truncated.zip").write_bytes(good.read_bytes()[:-1])
          with zipfile.ZipFile(root / "duplicate.zip", "w") as archive:
              archive.writestr("duplicate.txt", b"first")
              archive.writestr("duplicate.txt", b"second")
          # Independent Python-written APK Signing Block *framing*, not a
          # cryptographic signature. CRCs of ZIP members are authentic.
          data = good.read_bytes()
          end = len(data) - 22
          directory = int.from_bytes(data[end + 16:end + 20], "little")
          bogus_value = b"not-signed"
          pair = (4 + len(bogus_value)).to_bytes(8, "little") + (0x7109871A).to_bytes(4, "little") + bogus_value
          length = len(pair) + 24
          block = length.to_bytes(8, "little") + pair + length.to_bytes(8, "little") + b"APK Sig Block 42"
          wrapped = bytearray(data[:directory] + block + data[directory:])
          shifted_end = end + len(block)
          wrapped[shifted_end + 16:shifted_end + 20] = (directory + len(block)).to_bytes(4, "little")
          (root / "fake-apk-signing-block.zip").write_bytes(wrapped)
          with zipfile.ZipFile(root / "fake-apk-signing-block.zip") as archive:
              assert archive.testzip() is None and len(archive.namelist()) == 4
          malformed = bytearray(wrapped)
          new_directory = directory + len(block)
          malformed[new_directory - 24:new_directory - 16] = (length + 1).to_bytes(8, "little")
          (root / "bad-apk-signing-block.zip").write_bytes(malformed)
          bad_crc = bytearray(data)
          bad_crc[14] ^= 1  # local header CRC differs from central directory
          (root / "bad-local-crc.zip").write_bytes(bad_crc)
          PY
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/apk-like-structural-only.zip" | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/apk-like.zip > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/observed.json"
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/observed.json" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          record = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          result = record["normalized_result"]
          facts = result["header_facts"]
          assert record["rea_evidence_compatible"] is False
          assert record["coverage"]["status"] == "partial"
          assert result["format"] == "zip"
          assert facts["declared_entries"] == facts["checked_central_and_local_entries"] == 4
          assert facts["apk_structure_hint_only"] is True
          assert facts["legacy_signature_entry_count"] == 1
          assert "signature" in " ".join(record["limitations"]).lower()
          PY
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/fake-apk-signing-block.zip" | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/fake-signed.apk > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/signing-block-structure.json"
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/signing-block-structure.json" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          record = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          facts = record["normalized_result"]["header_facts"]
          assert record["rea_evidence_compatible"] is False
          assert record["coverage"]["status"] == "partial"
          assert facts["apk_signing_block_structure_present"] is True
          assert facts["apk_signing_block_id_pairs"] == 1
          assert facts["apk_v2_scheme_id_present"] is True
          assert facts["apk_v3_scheme_id_present"] is False
          assert "NOT cryptographic" in " ".join(record["limitations"])
          PY
          for invalid in truncated duplicate bad-apk-signing-block bad-local-crc; do
            if cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.zip" | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/bad.zip > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.out" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.err"; then
              echo "ERROR: REA preview accepted invalid $invalid archive" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.out"
            test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.err"
          done

      - name: Retain independent static ZIP fixtures and result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: rea-zip-preview-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rea-zip-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  runtime-merge-ci:
    name: Rust prospective-merge validation
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Checkout GitHub prospective merge
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:

          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

          EXPECTED_MERGE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_MERGE_SHA"

          printf 'PROSPECTIVE_MERGE_SHA=%s SOURCE_HEAD_SHA=%s\n' "$EXPECTED_MERGE_SHA" "$EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA"

      - name: Check all targets

      - name: Check all targets without remote filesystem
        run: cargo check --locked --all-targets --no-default-features

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Clippy without remote filesystem
        run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --no-default-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Install pinned nextest
        run: |

          cargo nextest --version

      - name: Install integration test tools
        run: |

          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y ripgrep python3-jsonschema
          rg --version

      - name: Test in isolated processes
        run: |
          umask 022
          cargo nextest run --locked --all-targets --all-features \
            --test-threads 1 --retries 0 --no-fail-fast

      - name: Test without remote filesystem in isolated processes
        run: |
          umask 022
          cargo nextest run --locked --all-targets --no-default-features \
            --test-threads 1 --retries 0 --no-fail-fast

      - name: Descriptor-relative file safety
        run: /usr/bin/python3 tests/file_capabilities.py

      - name: Frozen REA local mapping checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

        run: |

          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_v11_v4_session_binding_tests.py

          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_v10_single_v4_effect_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/chatgpt_v10_stream_custody_tests.py
          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/test_computer_http.py

          /usr/bin/python3 -B tests/full_operator_cancel_tests.py

          cargo nextest run --locked --all-targets --no-default-features \
            --test-threads 1 --retries 0 --no-fail-fast

      - name: Release build
        run: cargo build --locked --all-features --release --bins --examples

      - name: Release JavaScript MCP cancellation and recovery
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, os, subprocess, sys
          from pathlib import Path
          binary = Path("target/release/hepta-runtime").resolve(strict=True)
          with binary.open("rb") as stream:
              digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
          subprocess.run([
              sys.executable, "-u", "tests/rea_javascript_cancellation_external.py",
              "--runtime", str(binary), "--expected-runtime-sha256", digest,
              "--workspace", str(Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "rea-javascript-cancellation"),
              "--allow-owned-child-signals", "--allow-local-mcp",
          ], check=True)
          PY

      - name: Retain JavaScript cancellation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: rea-js-cancellation-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/rea-javascript-cancellation/
            !${{ runner.temp }}/rea-javascript-cancellation/hepta-runtime-qualified
            !${{ runner.temp }}/rea-javascript-cancellation/state/**
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Release binary REA parser and Linux syscall-denial smoke
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          binary="./target/release/hepta-runtime"
          test -x "$binary"
          printf '\x00asm\x01\x00\x00\x00' | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/release.wasm > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-good.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-good.err"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-good.err"
          python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["record_format"]=="hepta.rea.preview.v1" and r["normalized_result"]["format"]=="wasm" and r["rea_evidence_compatible"] is False and r["coverage"]["status"]=="partial"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-good.json"

          printf '\x00asm\x01\x00\x00\x00' | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/release.wasm --sandbox-probe > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-sandbox.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-sandbox.err"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-sandbox.err"
          python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["status"]=="file_and_network_syscalls_denied"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-sandbox.json"

          if printf '\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01' | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/invalid.elf > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-bad.out" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-bad.err"; then
            echo "ERROR: release worker accepted truncated ELF" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-bad.out"
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-release-bad.err"

      - name: Independent Python ZIP writer to shipped Rust worker static checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          binary="./target/release/hepta-runtime"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, zipfile
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "rea-zip-evidence"
          good = root / "apk-like-structural-only.zip"
          with zipfile.ZipFile(good, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_STORED) as archive:
              archive.writestr("AndroidManifest.xml", b"not a real Android manifest")
              archive.writestr("classes.dex", b"not actual dex code")
              archive.writestr("resources.arsc", b"not actual resources")
              archive.writestr("META-INF/CERT.RSA", b"not a real certificate")
          (root / "truncated.zip").write_bytes(good.read_bytes()[:-1])
          with zipfile.ZipFile(root / "duplicate.zip", "w") as archive:
              archive.writestr("duplicate.txt", b"first")
              archive.writestr("duplicate.txt", b"second")
          # Independent Python-written APK Signing Block *framing*, not a
          # cryptographic signature. CRCs of ZIP members are authentic.
          data = good.read_bytes()
          end = len(data) - 22
          directory = int.from_bytes(data[end + 16:end + 20], "little")
          bogus_value = b"not-signed"
          pair = (4 + len(bogus_value)).to_bytes(8, "little") + (0x7109871A).to_bytes(4, "little") + bogus_value
          length = len(pair) + 24
          block = length.to_bytes(8, "little") + pair + length.to_bytes(8, "little") + b"APK Sig Block 42"
          wrapped = bytearray(data[:directory] + block + data[directory:])
          shifted_end = end + len(block)
          wrapped[shifted_end + 16:shifted_end + 20] = (directory + len(block)).to_bytes(4, "little")
          (root / "fake-apk-signing-block.zip").write_bytes(wrapped)
          with zipfile.ZipFile(root / "fake-apk-signing-block.zip") as archive:
              assert archive.testzip() is None and len(archive.namelist()) == 4
          malformed = bytearray(wrapped)
          new_directory = directory + len(block)
          malformed[new_directory - 24:new_directory - 16] = (length + 1).to_bytes(8, "little")
          (root / "bad-apk-signing-block.zip").write_bytes(malformed)
          bad_crc = bytearray(data)
          bad_crc[14] ^= 1  # local header CRC differs from central directory
          (root / "bad-local-crc.zip").write_bytes(bad_crc)
          PY
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/apk-like-structural-only.zip" | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/apk-like.zip > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/observed.json"
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/observed.json" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          record = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          result = record["normalized_result"]
          facts = result["header_facts"]
          assert record["rea_evidence_compatible"] is False
          assert record["coverage"]["status"] == "partial"
          assert result["format"] == "zip"
          assert facts["declared_entries"] == facts["checked_central_and_local_entries"] == 4
          assert facts["apk_structure_hint_only"] is True
          assert facts["legacy_signature_entry_count"] == 1
          assert "signature" in " ".join(record["limitations"]).lower()
          PY
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/fake-apk-signing-block.zip" | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/fake-signed.apk > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/signing-block-structure.json"
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/signing-block-structure.json" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          record = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          facts = record["normalized_result"]["header_facts"]
          assert record["rea_evidence_compatible"] is False
          assert record["coverage"]["status"] == "partial"
          assert facts["apk_signing_block_structure_present"] is True
          assert facts["apk_signing_block_id_pairs"] == 1
          assert facts["apk_v2_scheme_id_present"] is True
          assert facts["apk_v3_scheme_id_present"] is False
          assert "NOT cryptographic" in " ".join(record["limitations"])
          PY
          for invalid in truncated duplicate bad-apk-signing-block bad-local-crc; do
            if cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.zip" | "$binary" rea-worker --selected-path=/controlled/bad.zip > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.out" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.err"; then
              echo "ERROR: REA preview accepted invalid $invalid archive" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.out"
            test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/rea-zip-evidence/$invalid.err"
          done

      - name: Retain independent static ZIP fixtures and result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: rea-zip-preview-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rea-zip-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
